description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 (minFDE20, measured in meters) varies with the Ratio parameter for five different trajectory prediction methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the Ratio, which ranges from 0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minFDE20, which ranges from 19 to 23 meters, also on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The TrajICL method (blue line with circular markers) shows a consistent decline from approximately 20.5 meters at a Ratio of 0 to about 18.5 meters at a Ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning method (orange line with circular markers) remains relatively high, starting at about 23.0 meters and slightly decreasing to around 22.5 meters. The FT method (green line with circular markers) begins at approximately 22.5 meters, dips to a low of about 21.5 meters around a Ratio of 0.4, and then rises slightly to about 21.0 meters. The LoRA 16 method (red line with circular markers) starts near 23.0 meters and decreases to about 22.0 meters. The LoRA 64 method (purple line with circular markers) begins at approximately 23.0 meters and decreases to about 22.0 meters.
